name: plugin.earth_engine_imagery
description: Google Earth Engine satellite imagery querying, spectral index computation (NDVI, NDWI, EVI), temporal compositing, and visual thumbnail preview engine

entrypoints.name: ee_search_image_collection
entrypoints.description: Search and filter satellite image collections (Sentinel-2, Landsat, MODIS) by spatial bounding box, temporal window, and cloud cover

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Spatial bounding box as [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat] in WGS84 coordinates

parameters.name: max_cloud_cover
parameters.description: Maximum allowable cloud cover percentage (0.0 to 100.0)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of candidate scenes to return

entrypoints.name: ee_compute_spectral_index
entrypoints.description: Compute multi-spectral vegetation and water indices (NDVI, NDWI, EVI, NBR) or custom normalized band equations

parameters.name: image_id
parameters.description: Target image asset ID or scene identifier

parameters.name: swir_band
parameters.description: Short-wave infrared band name for NDWI/NBR (default 'B11')

parameters.name: custom_formula
parameters.description: Optional custom formula when index_type is 'CUSTOM' (e.g. '(NIR - RED) / (NIR + RED)')

entrypoints.name: ee_composite_timeseries
entrypoints.description: Generate multi-temporal composite reductions (median, mean, min, max, greenest pixel) with QA cloud masking

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Spatial bounding box as [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat]

parameters.name: mask_clouds
parameters.description: Whether to apply QA pixel cloud masking before compositing

entrypoints.name: ee_get_image_thumbnail_url
entrypoints.description: Generate visual preview thumbnail URLs and map tile metadata for an Earth Engine image

parameters.name: bands
parameters.description: Band selection list for RGB or single band (e.g. ['B4', 'B3', 'B2'])

parameters.name: min_val
parameters.description: Minimum display value for contrast stretching

parameters.name: max_val
parameters.description: Maximum display value for contrast stretching

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: Optional hex color palette list for single-band visualization

entrypoints.name: ee_describe_image
entrypoints.description: Extract image properties, band definitions, spatial resolution, and CRS projection metadata
